text: To be no truce-breaker, nor tale-bearer, nor backbiter. To utter nothing against any man that he would not dare to tell him to his face. To turn no man from his door who sought food or shelter, even though he were a foe.
author: Peter Kropotkin
speaker: George Dasent
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter IV, Mutual Aid Among the Barbarians
